summary: Add the causality curriculum, guided lab activity tracking, and validated HTTP/MCP agent authoring access without changing scoring, planning, or adaptation semantics.
rationale: The curriculum and guided preparation evidence use the existing modular application, transactional store, practice sessions, scoring, learner model, and role-routed agent boundary. Authoring creates attributed content and never fabricates learner attempts, mastery, official grades, or calendar decisions.
authorization: The completed causality-lab feature was already in the user-owned working tree, and the user explicitly requested on 2026-09-20 that all completed features be merged into main with one commit per feature.
validation: The feature's recorded validation covered SQLite tests, Ruff, the Vite production build, isolated browser activity, content import, and a real stdio MCP client. The consolidated main branch is validated again after history assembly; this record does not claim independent scientific review.
rollback: Revert the causality feature commit. Preserve learner activity and source history in existing databases; removing the bundled curriculum or UI does not erase stored evidence. No algorithm version or external authority changes require rollback.
